subject.title: fix: block workspace dotenv endpoint overrides [AI]

question: Should every environment-variable name ending in `_ENDPOINT` be trusted-source-only and therefore ignored from workspace `.env` files?
rationale: The implementation and exact-head proof are sound, but the generic fail-closed policy intentionally changes existing operator behavior and reserves third-party and future variable names.

options.title: Accept the generic boundary
options.body: Treat all `_ENDPOINT` names as routing controls, update public documentation, and land the proven patch.

options.title: Add transition diagnostics
options.body: Keep the generic rule but first warn operators about ignored keys and supported relocation paths.

options.title: Narrow to current keys
options.body: Block only the reviewed Azure and OTLP endpoint variables to preserve arbitrary workspace names.

recommendation.title: Accept the generic boundary
recommendation.body: Treat all `_ENDPOINT` names as routing controls, update public documentation, and land the proven patch.
